# SetRack

> Android gym log. Fully offline: no account, no ads, no trackers and no internet
> permission. Data lives only on the phone. Free.

## Pages

- [Español](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/) · [English](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/en/) · [Português](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/pt/) · [Deutsch](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/de/) · [Français](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/fr/) · [Italiano](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/it/)
- Privacy policy: [es](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/privacidad/) · [en](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/en/privacy/) · [pt](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/pt/privacidade/) · [de](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/de/datenschutz/) · [fr](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/fr/confidentialite/) · [it](https://iggykimi.github.io/setrack-web/it/privacy/). Each home page also carries the full text (#privacidad).

## Verifiable facts

- The APK declares no INTERNET permission; its only system permission is VIBRATE (the tick when logging a set).
- Exercises, sets and weights are stored only in local storage.
- Manual backup file in Downloads, restore from that file, and CSV export.
- 61 base exercises with muscle and equipment; users can add their own.
- Estimated 1RM (Brzycki); progress by week, month, quarter or year.
- Suggests exercises by the sets each muscle still needs this week.
- Spanish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French and Italian; kilos or pounds.
- Status: internal testing on Google Play (no public link yet).
